selected.scope: Development of pure system feature/MCP coverage algebra and canonical Sa-plan workflow-backed declaration/observation storage; private fixture writes only until the fixed metadata path is independently reviewed. No production migration, coordinator mutation, identity enrollment, runtime start or admission. This foundation cannot close t1 until complete source reconciliation and real canonical persistence are verified.

snapshot.reference: Existing harness tracker is a 52-feature declaration/task projection, not all-system MCP availability. Reuse Sa-plan durable workflow evidence storage; no new scheduler/database authority.

criticality.rationale: Truthful complete feature/MCP inventory is prerequisite to exposing missing capabilities; independently scoped development does not require production coordinator recovery.

stpa.rationale: Missing, stale or self-declared MCP availability can falsely imply operational coverage; immutable declarations and typed contextual observations preserve unknown.

fmea.rationale: False availability has S5 O3 Det4 RPN60 severity floor5; analyst estimates, not empirical occurrence.

dependency.rationale: t2-contracts and r05-mcp-data require the inventory; urgency propagates without bypassing their authority prerequisites.

impact.rationale: One persistent evidence-backed feature model removes separate inconsistent inventory/availability claims across clients.

fmea_modes.cause: Declarations or stale/wrong-revision success presented as verified availability.
fmea_modes.effect: Incomplete system admitted or unsafe dispatch attempted.
fmea_modes.controls: Typed stage and observation separation, candidate/context/freshness binding, deny dominance, append-only canonical workflow evidence, private fixtures.

decision.summary: Select safe t1 foundation development; current complete-plan dashboard has no other ready task. Separate this scope from held production recovery. Final t1 acceptance remains unchanged.
alternatives: Unsafe live recovery/cutover without peer authority (rejected)
Pure tracker algebra and private canonical-store fixtures (selected)
counterevidence: Current connected MCP exposes only read_file and knowledge_search; no live tracker success is asserted.
Existing 52-feature catalog is scoped to harness and cannot establish all-system completeness.
assumptions: Repeated operator repair mandate authorizes scoped development bootstrap, not production admission.
decision.forecast: Within one bounded development slice, typed catalog and stale/foreign/fixture refusal laws can be verified without touching live coordinator history.
decision.falsifier: A missing catalog is green; a declaration or fixture becomes runtime usable; store bypasses Sa-plan; any production service is restarted.
acceptance: Pure catalog/observation types, finite input validation and bidirectional endpoint reconciliation.
Append-only declaration/evidence persistence via Sa-plan workflows, tested in private SQLite fixtures; no direct task SQL.
No declaration/fixture/stale/wrong-context evidence promotes usable; independent reference interpreter and law tests.
Full t1 remains incomplete until source coverage and canonical metadata path with review are observed.
decision.rollback: Preserve source evidence and private fixtures; no production runtime change to roll back.
decision.reviewer: Independent internal source review to be requested; not sovereign admission.
decision.budget: One source writer and one read-only reviewer; existing pinned Gleam/OTP; bounded private tests; no packages/paid inference/runtime actions.
residuals: Full source inventory, trusted runtime probe receipts and deployed MCP success remain unverified.

authority: development_only; source and private tests, no production
